decisions.briefing: Markets were quietly negative today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 threshold needed to fund a new position, so no buys were made despite 3 open slots; existing positions are being held and left to the automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, low-conviction trading, with the NASDAQ (-0.3%) underperforming the S&P 500 (-0.2%) slightly. There was no dominant catalyst driving the session, which is typical of consolidation periods after a strong run. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session to cite.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅下跌,成交氣氛清淡、方向不明,納斯達克(-0.3%)略遜於標普500(-0.2%)。市場缺乏明顯的催化因素,屬於強勢上漲後常見的整理格局。今日未提供具體新聞頭條可供引用。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today the portfolio's cash balance ($189.29) was too small to fund a new position, so rather than forcing a trade, the agent held cash and waited — discipline matters more than staying fully invested at all times.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」(Dry Powder)是指保留在場外、等待良機出現時再投入的現金。今日投資組合的現金餘額($189.29)不足以建立新倉位,因此系統選擇按兵不動、耐心等待,而非勉強交易——紀律比隨時滿倉更重要。
